verdict.rationale: Coinbase Onramp is documented as a widget/API letting end users buy crypto with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Coinbase account, delivered directly to a wallet, and the broader Onramp/Offramp docs describe bidirectional fiat-crypto movement suitable for embedding in a product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the embed flow and explicit confirmation of stablecoin-specific (vs generic crypto) purchase support in the widget.
